profile.entities: Sonam Limited (formerly Sonam Clock Limited), Morbi/Tankara, Gujarat · standalone results · no subsidiaries discussed
profile.subseg: Wall clocks (premium designer, digital calendar, Night Glow, decorative, lifestyle); moving into value/premium ₹5,000–15,000 range; nascent B2C

deepdive.sec: Consumer Durables — Clocks / Home Décor & Timepieces

bull_bear.body: Growth to be funded by internal accruals — "no requirement for now" for additional borrowing.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- Q1 growth non-repeatable; RM-timing tailwind unwinds → watch margin normalization.
- Margin sensitivity to raw-material prices (no pricing-power evidence beyond advance buying).
- Design IP not patented — relies on speed of refresh, not legal protection.
- Export softness on price competitiveness.
- Demand cyclicality tied to monsoon and festive season.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Founder-CMD (sole speaker), candid — volunteered that 75% growth is not sustainable rather than anchoring on it. Answers were brief and at times evasive on specifics (margin target, order book). Retail/small-fund-heavy Q&A.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- Real run-rate signal is the ₹40–50 cr Q2 minimum guide + 25–30% FY guide, NOT the 75% headline.
- Strategy shift from volume to value (higher-ASP clocks) is the margin lever to watch over FY27–28.
- B2C is optionality but immaterial today.

---
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

business.body: Single-segment (clocks), standalone entity. Channels: B2B (primary) plus newly started B2C on Flipkart/Amazon. Geographic mix: domestic pan-India + exports; exports softening slightly on price-led competitiveness.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- **In-house design engine**: continuous new-model development; management argues copycats take 6–12 months to replicate a model, by which time dials/colours/designs have already changed — sustaining a design-refresh lead over small unorganized players.
- **Scale / positioning**: claims to be India's **second-largest clock manufacturer** and the most prolific new-product introducer; plays in the ₹500+ price band vs unorganized sector's sub-₹500 focus, and beats imports on freight/cost via fully in-house manufacturing.
- **Replacement cost**: management estimates a comparable new plant would need **>₹200 cr** investment and years of model-library build; states current property value **>₹100 cr**.
business.title: 6a. Moat & competitive position (OPTIONAL)

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin 8.06%, PAT margin 4.49%. Margins move with raw-material price swings; Q1 benefited from a 6–7-month advance RM buying strategy (12-month RM plan) that locked in low costs before a price rise. Management positions advance procurement as a structural hedge against input inflation.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1 FY27 (this):** Revenue ₹66.57 cr (+75.6% YoY), PAT ₹3.00 cr (+127%); FY27 guide 25–30%; Q2 guide ₹40–50 cr min; value-product (₹5–10k) roadmap for FY28; B2C launched on Flipkart/Amazon; util 60–70%.
- _Q2 FY27 → check: did revenue land in ₹40–50 cr guide? margin normalization as RM tailwind unwinds; B2C traction; value-clock launches._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)

outlook.body:
- Revenue growth: full-year FY27 **25%–30%** (management "hopes" to sustain).
- Next-quarter (Q2 FY27) revenue: **₹40–50 crore minimum**; monsoon/tier-2-3 demand and festive season are swing factors.
- Margin: no numeric target; margins "fluctuate" with raw-material prices.
- Product/mix: develop value clocks in the **₹5,000–10,000** range in FY28 ("this year, 2027-28"); shift philosophy toward value over volume.
- Capex / commissioning: none announced.
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body: No formal order book quantified. Forward visibility framed as Q2 revenue of ₹40–50 cr minimum, supported by monthly new-model launches, festive-season demand, and B2C ramp (Flipkart, Amazon started "a few months" ago). Channels: corporate, pan-India local market, and exports.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- B2C e-commerce (Flipkart, Amazon) — early stage, monthly launches.
- Premiumization: value clocks ₹5,000–15,000 tied to home-interior spend ("people who buy ₹1–2 cr homes put up ₹1,000–15,000 clocks").
- Distribution expansion into underserved markets.
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Small-cap Morbi clock manufacturer posting explosive but non-repeatable Q1 (+75.6% revenue YoY) driven by a cheap raw-material inventory position while input prices rose; management guides steady-state 25–30% FY27 growth and is pivoting from volume toward higher-value (₹5,000–15,000) clocks plus a nascent B2C channel on Flipkart/Amazon.
